releases.notes:
Initial release

- Has been tested for a lot of edge cases
It should be compatible with any mods or custom datapack items.
It messes up with the 'max_stack_size' component, but restores it afterwards.

Known Issue:
- Hoppers can take the item from the cushion which makes it non-stackable.
- To restore the item, you will need to place it on a different cushion and remove it properly.

_I don't think I'll fix that unless Mojang adds a way to prevent items to go in hoppers._
